correctness.rationale: Checked explicit original (MK),(Pos),(Con) without assuming top preservation: on K_n={0,...,n-1} with ~x=n-1-x, binary meet preservation iff nondecreasing; Pos iff f(p)>=p for p=floor(n/2). Set c=floor((n-1)/2). For monotone f the Con inequality for x and t=z∧~z∈[0,c] reduces to either f(max(x,t))=f(x) or the raised value <=c, yielding the dichotomy f(c)<=c or constant prefix f(0)=...=f(c). Independently enumerated all maps n<=5 and all nondecreasing candidates n=6,7 directly against quantified axioms and formulas. Stars-and-bars gives T_{2h}=C(2h-1,h)^2+C(2h,h+1), T_{2h+1}=C(2h,h)^2+C(2h,h+1), n=1 exceptional T1=1; requiring f(n-1)=n-1 gives the corresponding U formulas. Central binomial asymptotics yield T_n~4^n/(2pi n), U_n~4^n/(4pi n). The all-n proof is symbolic, not inferred from checks.
